messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

message.content:
Here are the main train stations in Miami that typically allow pets (subject to Amtrak’s general pet policy):

| Station | Address | Notes on Pet Policy |
|---------|---------|---------------------|
| **Miami Central Station (Miami Intermodal Center)** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 | Pets are allowed in carriers or on leashes; no separate pet facilities. |
| **Miami Airport Station** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 (connected to the airport) | Same as Central Station – pets in carriers/leashed. |
| **Miami Beach Station** | 1 NE 1st St, Miami Beach, FL 33139 | Pets allowed in carriers or on leashes; no dedicated pet area. |
| **Hialeah Station** | 1000 NW 2nd Ave, Hialeah, FL 33012 | Pets allowed in carriers or on leashes; no dedicated pet area. |

**Quick tip:** Amtrak’s policy generally permits small pets in carriers or on leashes in the passenger car. For larger animals or special accommodations, it’s best to call Amtrak’s customer service or the specific station ahead of time.
